<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
  <title>Vibe2</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">
  <script src="scripts.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <main id="game"></main>
  <script>
    // Game initialization
    const game = {
      map: {
        width: 10,
        height: 10,
        tiles: new Array(10).fill(0)
      },
      player: {
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        direction: 'right'
      },
      enemies: [],
      ai: {
        behavior: 'basic',
        target: null
      },
      ui: {
        display: false
      },
      save: {
        state: {
          map: JSON.stringify(game.map),
          player: JSON.stringify(game.player),
          enemies: JSON.stringify(game.enemies),
          ai: JSON.stringify(game.ai)
        },
        persistence: true
      }
    };

    // Initialize game
    function init() {
      // Load saved state if exists
      if (game.save.state) {
        game.map = JSON.parse(game.save.state.map);
        game.player = JSON.parse(game.save.state.player);
        game.enemies = JSON.parse(game.save.state.enemies);
        game.ai = JSON.parse(game.save.state.ai);
      }

      // Create initial map
      for (let y = 0; y < game.map.height; y++) {
        for (let x = 0; x < game.map.width; x++) {
          game.map[y][x] = 0;
        }
      }

      // Place player
      game.player.x = 0;
      game.player.y = 0;

      // Place enemies
      game.enemies = [
        { x: 1, y: 1, direction: 'right' },
        { x: 1, y: 2, direction: 'left' }
      ];

      // Set UI
      game.ui.display = true;

      // Start game loop
      startGameLoop();
    }

    // Game loop
    function startGameLoop() {
      // Update AI
      game.ai.behavior.update(game.enemies);

      // Update player
      game.player.direction = game.ai.behavior.target;
      game.player.x += game.player.direction === 'right' ? 1 : -1;
      game.player.y += game.player.direction === 'down' ? 1 : -1;

      // Check for collision
      if (game.player.x < 0 || game.player.x >= game.map.width || game.player.y < 0 || game.player.y >= game.map.height) {
        game.ui.display = false;
        game.save.state = {
          map: JSON.stringify(game.map),
          player: JSON.stringify(game.player),
          enemies: JSON.stringify(game.enemies),
          ai: JSON.stringify(game.ai)
        };
        game.save.persistence = false;
        alert('Game over!');
        return;
      }

      // Check for enemy collision
      for (let enemy of game.enemies) {
        if (game.player.x === enemy.x && game.player.y === enemy.y) {
          game.ui.display = false;
          game.save.state = {
            map: JSON.stringify(game.map),
            player: JSON.stringify(game.player),
            enemies: JSON.stringify(game.enemies),
            ai: JSON.stringify(game.ai)
          };
          game.save.persistence = false;
          alert('You lost!');
          return;
        }
      }

      // Update UI
      game.ui.display = true;

      // Request next frame
      requestAnimationFrame(startGameLoop);
    }

    // Start game
    init();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
